description: China's Pinglu Canal, a key project of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor, achieved full water connectivity and entered the water-testing phase on Wednesday. title: China's Pinglu Canal enters water-testing phase

description: The Third World Conference of Sinologists opened on Wednesday in Dunhuang, a key hub on the ancient Silk Road in northwest China's Gansu Province. The event has seen scholars and cultural figures from around the world explore how Chinese civilization can contribute to addressing shared global challenges amid growing uncertainty. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Sinologists conference kicks off in China's Dunhuang

author: New China TV
description:
China has dispatched an anti-#Ebola medical team to the DRC for a three-month mission to support outbreak response efforts.
The Central African nation on May 15 confirmed its 17th Ebola outbreak since the virus was first identified in 1976, and #WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later.
title: Chinese medical team arrives in DR Congo to support Ebola response

author: New China TV
description: Famed for an ecological miracle, Liangping in China's Chongqing is accredited by the Ramsar Convention as an international wetland city. It has made the utmost use of the abandoned mines to rebuild them into a cluster of macro-wetlands with ditches, ponds, canals, and terrace fields. Join Xinhua to have a tour there and explore how small wetlands hold big environmental significance. #worldenvironmentday  (recorded)
title: Small wetlands, big environmental significance: A glimpse of ecological wonder in China's Liangping

title: Lao president tries Chinese-made quadruped robot

description:
On June 1, China Southern Airlines launched the first direct passenger route from Urumqi to Frankfurt, Germany.

This marks the first direct international passenger air route from northwest China's Xinjiang to Germany.

As of April 2026, Urumqi has opened over 30 international passenger routes.
title: China's Xinjiang gets first direct passenger air link to Germany

description:

They toured a transportation-themed museum, learned about China's bridge construction techniques, and joined local students in traditional indigo dyeing, experiencing Guizhou's blend of innovation and culture.

author: New China TV
description: A brand-new Airbus A321neo has become the first aircraft to benefit from Hainan Free Trade Port's zero-tariff policy since island-wide special customs operations began in late 2025. The aircraft, leased by Hainan Airlines, is expected to save nearly 6 million yuan in tariffs during its lease period, highlighting the growing benefits of Hainan's high-level opening-up.
title: Eyes on Hainan: Hainan's first zero-tariff aircraft clears customs after FTP upgrade
